title: One device, as the hub's config folder holds it
description: config/devices/<id>.json. What a superuser decided about one device. A key that is left out means: leave that as it is. No secret is ever in this file.

id.description: The device's id on this hub. It is also the file's name.

name.description: What people call it. Written by the hub. Renaming from this file is not built yet.

control.description: Whether people can control it. false: the hub only watches it and sends it nothing.

settings.description: Its own settings, by the names it gives them. Secrets are never here: they stay in the hub.

reach.description: What it may reach on the network. Each list, when given, is the whole list.

from.description: Where it came from. Written by the hub, for reading.

note.description: Anything worth saying about this device. The hub keeps it and never reads it.

allowed.description: host:port pairs, the same shape a driver's manifest asks in: a part in braces is filled from its settings. lan is any address on the local network. listen opens ports on the hub's computer.
